title: Resolve the tagline conflict
prompt: You're on `main` and want the `tagline` branch merged in. Put the steps in the order you'd run them to get from the conflict to a finished merge commit.
hints: Git must report the conflict before there's anything to fix, and `git status` tells you which files need you.
You fix the file before you check it, and you check it before you tell Git it's resolved.
The merge commit is always the very last step.
explanation: The merge stops at the conflict; `git status` lists the unmerged files. You open each one, edit it into the final text and delete every marker, then check the result (`git diff --check`, view the page, run the tests). Only then does `git add` mark it resolved, and `git commit` (or `git merge --continue`) records the merge commit. If anything goes wrong before that last step, `git merge --abort` returns you to where you started.

items.merge: Run `git merge tagline` and see `CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in index.html`.
items.status: Run `git status` to list the unmerged paths.
items.edit: Write the final tagline and delete the three marker lines.
items.check: Run `git diff --check` and view the page in a browser.
items.add: Run `git add index.html` to mark the conflict resolved.
items.commit: Run `git commit` to record the merge commit.
